subject: General Science
title: Rates of Reactions

outcomes.text: perform experiments involving the rate of chemical reactions,
explain factors that influence the rate of reactions in biological, chemical and physical processes,
appreciate the importance of manipulating factors affecting the rate of chemical and biological processes in day-to-day life.

content: Factors affecting the rates of reactions
inquiry_questions: How do various factors affect the rate of reactions?
suggested_learning_experiences: Discuss with peers the meaning of the rate of a chemical reaction.
Observe safety when carrying out activities to investigate rates of reactions.
Carry out experiments to investigate the rate of chemical reactions.
Carry out experiments to investigate factors that affect the rate of biological, chemical and physical processes (temperature, pressure, catalyst, light, concentration, surface area).
Discuss with peers the factors that affect the rate of reactions in biological, chemical and physical processes.
Use available digital devices and print media to research on the importance of optimum conditions in biological, chemical and physical processes.
coreCompetencies:
Communication and collaboration: as the learner discusses with peers the factors that affect the rate of chemical reactions.
Digital literacy: as the learner uses digital devices and print media to research on the importance of optimum conditions in biological, chemical and physical processes.
values:
Responsibility: as the learner carefully uses digital devices to search for information on the importance of optimum conditions in industrial processes.
Respect: as the learner respects others’ opinion while discussing with peers in a group the importance of efficient industrial processes.
pcis: Safety and security: as the learner observes safety measures when carrying out activities to investigate rates of reactions.
